records.question: What details are needed for an international transfer?
aliases: Do I need an IBAN and SWIFT code to send money abroad?
records.answer: A simulated international transfer needs only transfer type, a fictional recipient nickname, a GBP demo amount and optional note. Open Transfer request and review before confirming. Do not provide IBAN, account numbers, SWIFT/BIC or actual payment details.
records.question_zh: 国际转账需要哪些收款人信息？
